# GetListenerDistance <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetListenerDistance:Float32
```

**Returns:** The value right now.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells the value that [ListenerDistance](ListenerDistance) has set, or the one it has got to while it glides. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetListenerDistance()
```
